catalogue.note: Four text fields and a closed “Pension eligibility” accordion. The chevrons are the chevron/Right export turned 180° (back) and 90° (down), as the canvas shows them. The disabled button hugs its label, which keeps Figma’s measured 95px width. Chrome set the 14, 12 and 10px text and the 16px field text about 1px higher than Figma’s render, so those styles move down 1px: a measured correction, not a Figma value. Underlined links draw a heavier underline than Figma’s (both use the font’s own thickness). The status bar names SF Pro Text and renders in the system face.
